title: Results: Enforcing Document Permissions in Vector Search, an Experimental Comparison
description: The measured runs of the study whose plan was deposited before any of them at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24026269 (release prereg-v1 of this repository). This version archives the repository (the harness, the analysis and the paper's table scripts) at the GitHub release it was made from. The raw outputs of all 180 measured jobs (three seeds of every cell; W3 as one job per readable share), the report that the pre-registered analysis (bench.report) made from them and the figures (bench.figures) are assets of that GitHub release (results-raw.tar.gz and report.tar.gz, with SHA256SUMS covering both), not files of this record. report/collected.tsv lists every job with its workflow run. The raw outputs hold identifiers, scores, timings and plan shapes, not passage or message text; the workloads they refer to are the releases data-msmarco-v1 (derived from MS MARCO, non-commercial research only under its terms) and data-enron-v2 (derived from the CMU Enron corpus) of the repository. Code and history: https://github.com/muzakkirhussain011/rag-permission-bench. The study includes wardowl, the author's own library, as one arm; this is a declared conflict of interest.
